kind: pool: deploy/compose with gateway-authz.yml and provider-signer.yml, the configuration published by gateway-control, callers through front, the egress rules in force in the gateway's namespace and in the signer's; the PDP is the local Gatekeeper stack
operator_and_approver: Not recorded. The repository owner decided on 2026-11-19 (development plan 1.6) that this technical software has no operator and approver kept apart: this file records what was run, on which commits and images, and what was seen. It is a record of verification, not a gate decision.
